siwe.description: Sign-In With Ethereum — verify wallet ownership server-side

notes: Install core packages: pnpm add viem wagmi @wagmi/core @tanstack/react-query
Pick ONE wallet UI kit: RainbowKit, ConnectKit, or build custom with wagmi hooks.
RainbowKit: pnpm add @rainbow-me/rainbowkit — prettiest out of the box.
ConnectKit: pnpm add connectkit — most customizable, best for branded UIs.
Wrap your app with WagmiProvider + QueryClientProvider + wallet UI provider.
For SIWE (Sign-In With Ethereum): pnpm add siwe — generates a server-verifiable signature.
